filter_note.note: Saturday of Week 8 (Halloween college slate). Loudest by count: IND, BUF, GB, CHI, NE, KC, DAL, DEN, MIN, PIT/SEA. Dropped mostly college football (Texas Tech-Arizona, Florida-Georgia in Atlanta, Colorado-K-State, Nebraska blackout, Miami-UNC, Baylor-UCF, Indiana GameDay, Big 12 commissioner), other sports (Diamondbacks, Blues/Flyers jerseys, Sixers-Knicks, F1 Mexico, NASCAR, NHRA, Devils, FC Cincinnati, Northampton Saints rugby, esports), cross-club leftovers (Drew Brees tier list, 2026 draft third round, Lamar story parked on unrelated clubs), gags and merch (Verse Key & Peele, Watson hecklers, Colts superfan anthem, Deebo TikTok, Bills end zone design, Allen charity hat, Steelers host dog bet, Mahomes-Hill podcast), nostalgia (Roquan trade anniversary, Travis Hunter 2024), politics, and items last updated before the 24h window (Titans rule out Tate, Eagles DeVonta Smith final report). CIN, HOU, TB had no club-room story in the pool.
